purpose: Bounded whole-day emitter coverage and external label cross-check; no detector comparison or 45-day acquisition
population_name: all Ethereum Beanstalk Diamond-emitted event logs

logs.note: Listing verifies discoverability only. Pin HEAD/If-Match and validate acquired bytes separately.

blocks.note: Listing verifies discoverability only. Pin HEAD/If-Match and validate acquired bytes separately.

transactions.note: Listing verifies discoverability only. Pin HEAD/If-Match and validate acquired bytes separately.

acquisition_command_argv: all Ethereum Beanstalk Diamond-emitted event logs

params: <each positive transaction hash from label manifest>

verification_sequence: Fetch receipt for each labelled transaction; require non-null success status, transactionHash, transactionIndex, blockHash, blockNumber and complete logs.
Fetch eth_getTransactionByHash and eth_getBlockByHash(blockHash,false); verify hash/index membership and timestamp.
Archive exact responses with provider, collection time, errors, byte count and SHA-256; do not call explorer extraction a full RPC receipt.
Join core/diamond logs from each receipt against the independently selected emitter stream; keep all other receipt logs for semantic cross-check only.
receipt_path.alternative: AWS transaction projection may provide receipt-derived columns; inspect schema first. Joining those columns with logs is not a downloaded original RPC receipt. Label evidence type explicitly.

validation_gates: Untruncated partition listing; whole UTC day headers contiguous with unique block hashes and parent links.
Scan every emitter-address row; preserve all matching topics and rows; check log identities/order/timestamps and missing fields.
Resolve each externally labelled transaction against acquired rows; missing or conflicting labels stay unresolved.
For semantic features, reconstruct historical module/facet deployments; source commit date is not bytecode evidence.
Store separate immutable acquisition manifest; this plan never substitutes for an executed acquisition.
scope_limit: All emitter logs, narrower than all protocol calls/transactions or all external token outflows.
